title: PR #36990 added the support app's CourseTeamManageAPIView with only IsAuthenticated, without the support-role gate every sibling support view uses, so any learner can probe arbitrary accounts and instructors can read other users' course roles.

findings.explanation: The diff introduces new serializer code with no direct SQL queries. The code uses Django ORM serializers (ModelSerializer) with CourseOverview model, which handles parameterized queries internally. No raw SQL or string concatenation of user input is present.

The test file shows that course team management API endpoints exist with authorization checks, but the actual view implementation is not included in this diff. Tests show role-based access control (instructor sees only their courses, non-instructors see none), suggesting authorization is implemented. However, without viewing the actual view code (e.g., CourseTeamManagementAPIView), we cannot verify if authorization checks are complete and correctly implemented. The GET endpoint accepts email/user_id parameters and returns filtered results based on user role, which suggests authorization logic exists but needs verification in the view implementation.

evidence.content:
def test_get_api_instructor_can_only_see_their_courses(self):
        """GET API: Course instructor sees only courses they have access to."""
        self.client.login(
            username=self.instructor_user.username, password=TEST_PASSWORD
        )
        resp = self.client.get(self.url, {"email": self.user.email})
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200)

        course_ids = [course["course_id"] for course in resp.data]
        self.assertIn(str(self.extra_courses[0].id), course_ids)
        for i in range(1, 3):
            self.assertNotIn(str(self.extra_courses[i].id), course_ids)

findings.suggested_fix: Review the actual view implementation (not provided in this diff) to verify: 1) Authorization checks prevent unauthorized users from viewing/modifying other users' course roles; 2) Proper permission decorators (e.g., @require_permission) are used; 3) User ownership/access is validated before returning course data.
